description:
What the federal 'no tax on overtime' deduction is worth: only the half in time-and-a-half counts, capped at $12,500 ($25,000 joint). Takes overtime hours and hourly rate, or the overtime pay on the stubs, or W-2 box 12 TT; returns the deduction, the estimated federal income tax saved, the Schedule 1-A lines and a worksheet link. Same engine as tip_overtime_deduction.

Example questions:
- "I worked 300 hours of overtime at $24 an hour, how much is no tax on overtime worth?"
- "My stubs show $9,000 of overtime pay, what can I deduct?"
- "Does double time count for no tax on overtime?"

agi.description: Adjusted gross income (Form 1040 line 11b), dollars. If unknown, total yearly pay is a fair stand-in.

box12_tt.description: W-2 box 12 code TT, if they have the W-2

filing_status.description: single, mfj (married filing jointly), mfs (married filing separately), hoh (head of household), qss (qualifying surviving spouse)

overtime_hours.description: Hours over 40 in a workweek, added up for the year

overtime_pay.description: Total overtime pay on the stubs for the year (the whole 1.5x or 2x amount)

salaried_exempt.description: true if FLSA-exempt (most salaried managers): nothing qualifies
